title: Tensoring by finite locally free module is exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\mathcal P$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module: there is an open cover $(V_a)$ of $X$ such that $\mathcal P|_{V_a}\cong\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d_a}$ for integers $d_a\geq0$ (compare the constant-rank notion of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]). The functor on $\mathcal O_X$-modules sending $\mathcal G$ to $\mathcal P\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ preserves short exact sequences (equivalently, is exact). Tensor products and the module category are as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Proof, sentence asserting exactness of F^vee tensor -

proof.text: Fix $x\in X$ and choose $V_a$ containing $x$ with $\mathcal P|_{V_a}\cong\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d_a}$. Taking germs of the $d_a$ basis sections and their inverse coordinate maps gives $\mathcal P_x\cong\mathcal O_{X,x}^{\oplus d_a}$ as $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. The integer may vary with $x$; only this one neighbourhood is used.

source.place: Modules, Definition 17.14.1 (finite locally free), and Lemma 17.17.2 (Tag 05NE), proof of the forward local-free case

proof.text: For any $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$, naturality of the stalk-tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-tensor] identifies $(\mathcal P\otimes\mathcal G)_x$ with $\mathcal P_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\mathcal G_x$ and the stalk of a tensor map with $1_{\mathcal P_x}\otimes g_x$. Under the basis of step 1, the map $\mathcal O_{X,x}^{\oplus d_a}\otimes\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal G_x^{\oplus d_a}$ sends $e_i\otimes m$ to the tuple with $m$ in coordinate $i$ and zero elsewhere; its inverse sends $(m_i)_i$ to $\sum_i e_i\otimes m_i$. Thus tensoring on the stalk is the finite direct-sum functor $\mathcal G_x\mapsto\mathcal G_x^{\oplus d_a}$, including $d_a=0$.

Take a short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal G_1\xrightarrow{u}\mathcal G_2\xrightarrow{v}\mathcal G_3\to0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] its sequence of stalks is exact at each $x$ (including injectivity and surjectivity). Under step 2, tensoring its stalk sequence with $\mathcal P_x$ is the direct sum of $d_a$ copies of that sequence. Kernels, images, and surjectivity of maps between finite tuples are computed coordinatewise, so this direct sum is short exact, also when $d_a=0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] in the reverse direction, $0\to\mathcal P\otimes\mathcal G_1\to\mathcal P\otimes\mathcal G_2\to\mathcal P\otimes\mathcal G_3\to0$ is exact as a sequence of sheaves. The identifications in step 2 are natural, so these are the actual tensor maps.
